textual.observation: The presentation promotes an invitation-only cryptocurrency opportunity as highly profitable and links bonus eligibility to purchasing one of five product packages.

evidence.quote: The OneCoin provides a once in a lifetime opportunity.
this opportunity is only available through an invitation basis
do you want to become the next cryptocurrency millionaire
to purchase any of our five product packages

textual.context: Promotional business-presentation language describing an offer; no separate warning, reporting, parody, or quotation context is identified in these records.
textual.potential_relevance: The promised high-return outcome is linked to invitation-only participation and purchase of product packages, creating a reward-and-payment relationship for later context assessment.
textual.limitations: The records do not establish whether package purchase is required for all benefits, whether the opportunity produced returns, or whether the claims are accurate.

textual.observation: The program promises percentage-based bonuses from personal sales, business volume, and team members who join under a sponsor.

evidence.quote: Direct Sales and Network Bonus You get 10% bonus on all personal sales associated to the business volume
The member that joins your team and with you as a sponsor will be placed on your right and your left side.
During your first 30 days from your first purchase on a product package, you can receive an additional 10% on direct sales.

textual.context: The claims are presented as part of a promotional bonus-plan explanation.
textual.potential_relevance: Financial rewards are explicitly linked to package purchases, sales, sponsorship, and team-member recruitment, forming an observable money-and-recruitment relationship.
textual.limitations: The records do not establish actual payout history, eligibility for each bonus, or whether the described team structure operated as stated.

textual.observation: The presentation claims that token splits can multiply holdings and states that tycoon status can result in four times the money.

evidence.quote: this means you double your amount of tokens after a split
by holding a tycoon status you can split up to two times that means four times your money

textual.context: Promotional return claims are presented within an explanation of token benefits and status levels.
textual.potential_relevance: A stated multiplication of money is tied to holding a specific status and participating in token splits, creating a return claim with stated conditions.
textual.limitations: The records do not establish whether the multiplication was guaranteed, how tycoon status was obtained, or whether any token split occurred.

textual.observation: The speaker urges early joining and describes points collected from people joining later as redeemable for holidays, luxury items, and exclusive rewards.

evidence.quote: So join now as you collect more points from the people joining after you.
Points can be redeemed for items such as holidays, luxury items, and exclusive rewards.
so keep your momentum and build your team because the clock is ticking

textual.context: Promotional recruitment language connects urgency, team growth, and rewards.
textual.potential_relevance: The promised rewards are linked to joining early and collecting points from later joiners, creating an explicit recruitment-and-reward relationship.
textual.limitations: The records do not specify the points' monetary value, redemption conditions, or whether rewards were delivered.

textual.observation: The presentation says members receive free gold coins, with each coin described as backed by one milligram of solid gold.

evidence.quote: each coin is backed up with one milligram of solid gold.
These coins you receive for free as a member of ONE.

textual.context: The statement is part of a promotional description of membership benefits.
textual.potential_relevance: Membership is linked to a promised tangible asset with a stated gold-backing amount, creating an offer relationship requiring later assessment of the asset and its conditions.
textual.limitations: The records do not establish the coins' form, availability, redemption terms, or whether the stated backing existed.

visual.observation: A presentation slide describes OneCoin/OneTokens as a cryptocurrency and says viewers should obtain as many tokens as possible, with the statement that having more tokens means more profit; it also describes converting tokens into a real coin in a later phase.
visual.context: Promotional presentation slide titled "OUR VISION" describing a three-phase token process.
visual.potential_relevance: The promised profit and future conversion outcome are directly linked to acquiring or holding more tokens, which may merit review as a reward/return claim tied to an acquisition action.
visual.limitations: The frames do not establish whether the tokens could actually be acquired, converted, or used, or whether any stated returns occurred.

visual.observation: A slide titled "DIRECT SALES AND NETWORK BONUS" says members are encouraged to build a business and team, receive a 10% bonus on personally generated sales, and have members who join placed under them or elsewhere in their network; it also states that 60% of payments go to a cash account and 40% fund a mandatory account.
visual.context: Promotional slides presenting a network diagram and bonus/payment allocation.
visual.potential_relevance: A promised percentage-based payment is linked to recruiting or building a member network and generating sales, with a stated split of the resulting payments between cash and a mandatory account.
visual.limitations: The frames do not show actual enrollment, payment processing, contract terms, eligibility requirements, or whether the bonus was paid.

visual.observation: A slide titled "SPLITS" states that as more members join and demand for tokens increases, the token price rises, and says members can split tokens so they receive double their money; a table and market-chart image are also shown.
visual.context: Promotional presentation slide linking increased membership and token demand with a claimed price increase and token-splitting opportunity.
visual.potential_relevance: The slide presents a claimed doubling of money tied to joining conditions and token demand, which may merit review as a return claim connected to participation in the token scheme.
visual.limitations: The exact split terms are not fully legible, and the frames do not establish market activity, actual price changes, or realized returns.

visual.observation: A slide titled "REWARD-THE-STARS LEADERSHIP PROGRAM" says top performers may join a leadership team and receive rewards for hard work and outstanding performance every three to six months, ranging from gold to watches or a car.
visual.context: Promotional rewards-program slide showing a watch and a car.
visual.potential_relevance: High-value rewards are linked to becoming a top performer and joining a leadership group, with a stated recurring promotion interval and performance condition.
visual.limitations: The frames do not specify the performance requirements, number of rewards, eligibility rules, or whether the displayed items were actually awarded.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it urges viewers to buy a product package and build a team to earn from recruits’ sales, including bonuses tied to team placement and multiple generations. It reinforces that recruitment pitch with claims that joining early raises the token’s value and that token splits can multiply participants’ money. The presentation is soliciting participation, not teaching a trading method or reporting on someone else’s offer.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: S06 is primary because the payment plan links earnings to a left/right sales-team structure, volume on the weaker side, and matching bonuses across generations; the speaker explicitly tells viewers to buy packages and build their teams.
